name: three-brains-in-a-trench-coat
why: Opens on "You are three brains in a trench coat pretending to be one person" as the coat flaps open on a lizard, a shrew and tiny YOU; the lizard drives them off a cliff, the charred coat spends its genius on arguing and missiles, and the only suspect in the line-up is one hydrogen atom, still on fire.

name: one-hundred-and-fifty-seats
why: Opens on YOU's brain as a 150-seat cinema filled with coworkers he tolerates and Elvis while Grandma stands in the aisle; outside its walls, 10,000 malaria deaths are a printed number smaller than a mosquito, the neighbour's dog barks YOU's hair flat, and the number ticks up by one while nobody looks.

name: barely-alive-is-good-business
why: Opens on a grinning weatherman forecasting "Every single one of you is going to die" for a president and a pauper under one cloud; the bread burns, the poster rips on cavemen clubbing with missiles that rain yachts and billionaires, and the drug company's building parks the patient's slider at BARELY ALIVE because that is where the register rings.
